items.t: CVT whine or hum that ends in transmission failure
items.job: Replace CVT with new or remanufactured unit
items.note: Owners report dealer quotes of about $9,000–$16,000; a used transmission can cost less.

items.t: Windshield chips and cracks easily
items.job: Replace windshield and recalibrate front camera
items.note: A chip repair costs far less if done early.

items.t: A/C blows warm air on and off
items.job: A/C diagnosis and bulletin repair
items.note: May be covered under warranty or by the bulletin.

items.t: Water on the floor from a blocked A/C drain
items.job: Clear A/C drain tube

items.t: Musty smell from the A/C vents
items.job: Evaporator foam cleaning and cabin filter

items.t: Blower fan keeps running after the car is off
items.job: Blower circuit diagnosis and bulletin repair

items.t: Dead or weak 12-volt battery
items.job: Replace 12V battery
items.note: A parasitic drain test adds about an hour if the battery keeps dying.

items.t: Battery drain from accessory fog lights
items.job: Diagnose and repair accessory fog lamp drain

items.t: Electronic parking brake may not engage or release (recall)
items.job: Recall 17V-717: brake computer reprogramming

items.t: Parking brake briefly applies when downshifting (service campaign)
items.job: Service campaign H0L: software update and switch cover
items.note: The campaign has expired, but ask a dealer.

items.t: Parking brake warning or "See Dealer" message
items.job: Diagnose and repair electronic parking brake fault
items.note: Range covers a switch up to a rear caliper motor.

items.t: Brake pedal or steering vibration after tire service
items.job: Torque lug nuts and resurface or replace front rotors

items.t: Rear wheel hub bolts may loosen (recall)
items.job: Recall 18V-710: replace rear hub and carrier

items.t: Rear seat belt may not lock properly (recall)
items.job: Recall 19V-877: replace rear seat belt

items.t: Pre-collision braking may not work (recall)
items.job: Recall 22V-107: activate radar sensor

items.t: Humming wheel bearing
items.job: Replace one wheel bearing/hub assembly

items.t: Tire pressure light from a failing sensor
items.job: Replace one tire pressure sensor and relearn

items.t: Tire roar above 45 mph
items.job: Inspect, rotate and balance tires
items.note: If tires must be replaced, a set costs roughly $600–$900.

items.t: Squeaking rear door handles
items.job: Lubricate or repair rear door handles per bulletin

items.t: Blurry logo from the mirror puddle lights
items.job: Replace mirror puddle light

items.t: Fuel range estimate not accurate
items.job: Diagnose fuel gauge and sender
